label: synthetic recording
note: Hand-written responses shaped like the Anthropic Messages API (and Claude Code JSON output for the composer) for the offline demo. The composer answers the demo idea and the three open-box examples (dog walking, the Excel skill, cafe bills) and the landlord sentence, and one sentence ("Bike repairs at home for families in Bristol.") whose two plan answers both use a block Chausar does not have, so the demo can show the refused screen; any other sentence has no recording. The other answers are the same whatever you type, except that each delivery fixture matches only its own figure refs or practice files, the agent turns match their practice files and each plan rewrite matches its own kind of plan. Not captured from a live account. No paid call was made.
